annotations.text:
Tacet mobile — batch one
The shell, Home (A6 Digest) and Orders (A1 Worklist), derived from tacet-desktop-patterns.md v4.6 rather than patched from the current phone build. Light Paper shown; dark is a token swap only.

Sample data is the app's own (RT-…047, Chen Meiling, ¥312), retimed to the English US formats §1.18 requires.
What changes vs the live phone chrome: red count badges → one 6px Sage dot · brass active tab → Ink 500 · 10px/800 labels → 13px Inter 500 sentence case · uppercase sheet headings → sentence case.

The unseen card replaces the "NEW" pill: --td-unseen surface + inset 4px Sage edge, settling to Paper over 600ms on open. Inset shadow, never a border — an indicator that resizes its row makes the list jump.

One Dusk element: the header's New order. The FAB is gone — a floating circle is not in the system, and §1.7 puts the primary in the header.

The drawer, on a phone. Pinned block is exactly two rows: identifier + ONE status pill, then the action row — 3 controls at this width (state action · workhorse · ⋯), with the workhorse holding the right edge.

Actions are Secondary: the sheet inherits the page's Dusk budget, and Orders already spent it. The Dusk here is the auto-routed badge — tacet acting, which is exempt.

Every page ships all six states. Loading has no status line and no chip counts — a real number is not known yet, and §1.7's honesty rule forbids inventing one. Empty and no-results are different sentences: one is a compliment, the other is a search that missed.
